verdict.rationale: cubic is an AI code review product with an IDE/CLI presence and generated fixes, so inline completion is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence documents inline code completions or next-edit suggestions while typing. The closest features are adjacent and earn no credit: the CLI reviews local changes on demand, 'Fix with cubic' pushes fixes to a PR branch, and 'Add to AI chat' answers questions about selected code.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive inline code completions and next-edit suggestions as I type
